query: SELECT cm.id, cm.title, cm.totalLessons as stored_total, COUNT(cl.id) as actual_total FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title, cm.totalLessons ORDER BY cm.id;
